profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a graduate of Western Washington University and a Software engineer at Microsoft working on Azure. 

In my free time I like to play guitar, exercise, and read. I think it is healthy to keep a work life balance so I try to make time for my hobbies when I can.

Feel free to reach out to me for any reason.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Developer for Azure Batch. A distributed compute service that provides cloud computing on demand.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack developer for Alarm.com. Working in the OpenEye section on commercial software for cloud-based security management systems using React and Spring.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
Tutored groups of over 30 students a day on core Computer Science principles.
Presented talks on topics such as Machine Learning and Statistics.
Instituted a more inclusive community by providing underclassmen free tutoring.

positions.title: Object Oriented Design Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Evaluated the work of over 30 students on code quality and proper design.
Ensured students knew UML Diagrams, Sequence Diagrams, SOLID principles, and Use Cases.
Met with students to provide feedback on homework and answer questions.
